newsitem.title: USA: Effective Management sees Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Effective Management sees Q1 loss.

text.p: Effective Management Systems Inc, which provides manufacturing software, said Thursday it expects to report an estimated net loss of $750,000 to $950,000, or $0.19 to $0.24 a share, for the fiscal first quarter ended February 28.
It said the loss primarily reflects a delay in the finalization of a major contract.

The company said it expects to close on the contract with an unnamed Fortune 500 manufacturer during the second quarter ending May 31. It added it may also take other measures to help improve the profitability of the current quarter.

The company said that the delay in the finalization of this contract, plus some softness in new-account sales, mean that first-quarter revenues and net results will fall short of initial internal projections.

"Our plan for the quarter was predicated on the release of this important order, to which we have devoted considerable resources during the last two years," Michael Dunham, president, said in a statement. "Efforts to secure large contracts like this one are part of our strategy for growing the company, but the vagaries of dealing with such crucial individual pieces of business sometimes can cause significant, unanticipated adverse impacts."
